segments.contextAfter: Best practices

segments.contextBefore: When people enter a custom value, it’s not added to the list of choices.
segments.contextAfter: **Populate the field with a meaningful default value from the list.** Although the field can be empty by default, it’s best when the default value refers to the hidden choices.
